feeds.title: UTV Guide
feeds.description: The focus of this site is everything UTV - Maverick, YZX1000R, Rhino, RZR, Teryx, RANGER, Prowler, Pioneer, etc. From racing to working on the ranch. From adventure rides to UTV events. From completely stock to fully modified. We are UTV enthusiasts that eat, drink, and sleep this stuff. Product Reviews, Buildup, Trip reports, Industry News.

feeds.title: UTV Action
feeds.description: UTV Action Magazine is a website that covers all things related to UTVs (Utility Terrain Vehicles). It features news, reviews, tests, and buyer's guides on UTVs from all major manufacturers.

feeds.title: Side By Side Stuff
feeds.description: On our blog, you'll find exclusive store news, industry updates, and other topics of interest for all side-by-side enthusiasts. No matter how long you've been riding or what model you choose to go with, there's something for every SxS rider and off-road enthusiast. SideBySideStuff is an online retailer of side-by-side parts and accessories.

feeds.title: UTV Off-Road Magazine
feeds.description: UTV Off-Road Magazine is a website and magazine dedicated to UTVs and side-by-sides. They offer in-depth reviews of new vehicles, custom builds, trail rides, products, and events.

feeds.title: UTV Canada
feeds.description: UTV Canada is a family-run company that was built out of passion and commitment to the lifestyle. Our mission is to help Canadian off-road enthusiasts transform their rides so they can experience more. We provide high-quality aftermarket parts and accessories for UTVs.

feeds.title: R1 Industries Blog
feeds.description: R1 Industries is an off-road company, ships side-by-side (UTV) parts, and accessories to you. A full-service UTV shop in Lindon, Utah, specializes in repairs, maintenance, and upgrades for side-by-sides.

feeds.title: Aftermarket Assassins Tech Blog
feeds.description: Aftermarket Assassins is a small company dedicated to providing the possible power to your vehicle. We are a UTV performance facility located in Western Wisconsin.

feeds.title: UTV Sports Magazine
feeds.description: UTV Sports Magazine, founded in 2014, is monthly digital publication covering all racing and recreation interests of UTV and side-by-side enthusiasts. Our team of professional editors will be covering all aspects of UTV recreation which includes off-road racing, desert adventures, exploring trails and wooded areas, as well as sand duning. We will also feature new vehicle introductions, buyer's guides, race coverage, team profiles, technical and how-to articles, as well as recreation areas.

feeds.title: UTV Planet Magazine
feeds.description: UTV Planet Magazine delivers the latest UTV Industry News, UTV Models, UTV Reviews, and UTV Racing updates plus much more! UTV Planet Magazine is a Canadian Magazine dedicated to UTV and Side X Side Reviews, News, Racing, and more.

feeds.title: UTV Ride
feeds.description: UTV Ride is here to keep UTV enthusiasts informed about what's going on in the market, we write about the newest trends, events, news, and product launches.

feeds.title: ClearlyTough Blog
feeds.description: You'll discover information about UTV windshields, riding locations, UTV maintenance, safety guidelines, jamborees, and more in our Clearly Tough blog. Clearly Tough is an innovator with over 15 years of experience in plastics. We provide high-quality and most versatile UTV windshields on the market.

feeds.title: Rad Parts Blog
feeds.description: Rad Parts is a U.S.A-based UTV store that provides side-by-side UTV parts. Everything you need for your UTV adventures can be found right here, we carry a wide range of various items which include drive belts, goggles, wheels, ATV-UTV lug nuts, rugged radios, bumpers, winches, and more.

feeds.title: The COM Blog
feeds.description: The COM is a plug n' play off-road communication system that delivers communication between drivers and passengers and other cars. We offer stereo headsets for helmets, over the head or behind the head.

feeds.title: UTV Underground
feeds.description: UTVUnderground is the go-to site for all the latest news and insight surrounding the UTV industry. We aim to provide members, readers, and visitors with the best experience of any ATV site on the web. To always provide fresh and original content without relying upon competition and to always stay true to the sport.

feeds.title: UTV Driver
feeds.description: Follow the UTV Driver Magazine and Stay up to date with the latest UTV news, UTV race updates and schedules, and information from around the UTV and side-by-side industry. UTV Driver magazine is the source for UTV real-world tests and incredible pictures, aftermarket reviews, exotic adventures & more.
